title: 第五章：枪火
content_zh:
米亚点了点头，但又马上摇头。
在废品终点站，有一种东西最为稀缺，那就是食物，那些不思生产只靠拾荒为生的流民，基本都在饥饿的边缘徘徊。
苏晓在怀中掏出几块压缩饼干，这是他随身携带的应急食物。
他观察过，在‘废品终点站’的远处就有一片森林，他手中有枪，并不会为了食物而发愁。
米亚有些畏惧的接过一块压缩饼干，她从没见过这种食物。
在苏晓的指导下，米亚剥开了压缩饼干，小心的咬了一口。
“好吃~。”
已经饥肠辘辘一天的少女，狼吞虎咽的吃了起来。
“你叫米亚吧，带我离开这里，这几块饼干都是你的。”
吃光手中压缩饼干的米亚，直直的盯着苏晓手中那几块压缩饼干，咽了下口水。
“可以，但你不能伤害我。”
苏晓没有回答对方，而是从那间破旧房屋内翻出，恢复了一些的米亚紧随其后。
“你要去哪？你不是‘废品终点站’的居民吧？”
苏晓脚步突然停止，眼中浮现寒芒，将手中一块压缩饼干扔在地上，之后一脚踩碎。
“带我离开这里，其他不要问。”
如果少女米亚表现出任何异常，苏晓那只紧枪的手，就会对准米亚的额头。
米亚被苏晓的举动吓了一跳，退后几步。
“好~，好的。”
米亚不敢再说，快步走在前方。
“带我去‘哥亚王国’的入口。”

苏晓警惕的打量着四周，不时能看到目露凶光的流民，那些流民注意到苏晓手中的枪后，马上收起贪婪的目光。
回忆着动漫中得到的情报，苏晓开始思考接下来的对策。
所谓‘废品终点站’，其实就是一座大型垃圾场，因为‘哥亚王国’在城外倾倒了大量的生活垃圾，才有了如今的景象。
那些目露凶光的流民，原本只是‘哥亚王国’的居民，这些人或是犯了重罪，又或是得罪了贵族，才被驱赶到此。
垃圾**后产生一种带有毒素的青烟，在‘废品终点站’中蔓延，时刻侵蚀着流民的生命。
最明显的体现是，苏晓的生命值已经从100%，下降到98%。
在‘废品重点站’中没有医生，没有食物，犯罪与疾病在此蔓延，这里是无法地带，一切都以力量的强弱为准。
通过米亚的领路，苏晓很快走出‘废品终点站’，来到一面高墙前。
黑石堆砌的高墙耸立，一扇不大的城门出现在苏晓视线内。
“只能到这里了，‘哥亚王国’有法律，流民不能进入城中，一旦发现就会被处死。”
米亚虽然在和苏晓说话，但眼睛却一直盯着苏晓手中的压缩饼干。
将压缩饼干抛给米亚，苏晓不再理会对方，米亚也直接跑开，给苏晓领路只是因为食物的诱惑，没有其他原因。
‘哥亚王国’城门大开，城门两侧站着几名守卫。
这只是侧门，作用是方便倾倒垃圾。
那些守卫虽然看似懒散，但眼中却不时闪过寒光，这些守卫应该经常杀人，杀那些意图闯入城中的流民。
苏晓隐藏在一旁，并没着急进入城中，他在等待时机。
和那些守卫硬拼根本不可能，海贼世界的居民体质都异常强大，少女米亚在被他重击后，居然能在短时间内恢复正常，这让苏晓警惕起来。
苏晓猜测，那些守卫的属性，至少都是在十点以上，甚至可能更高。
一小时、两小时，直到三小时后，已经到了中午，气温快速提升，天气炎热起来，苏晓等待的机会，终于出现。
一辆装满生活垃圾的马车从城中驶出，刺鼻的腐臭味传出老远，那些守卫根本没去看那辆马车，反而下意识退开几步。

“各位大人，需要例行检查一下吗。”
车夫将马车停下，有些畏惧那些守卫。
“赶紧走，臭死了。”
守卫厌烦的挥着手掌，没有丝毫检查的意思。
远处的苏晓在看到这一幕后，眉头一挑，快步跟上那辆马车。
马车在深入垃圾山后，找了一处空地开始倾倒垃圾，之前还唯唯诺诺的车夫，腰间赫然多出一把匕首，弱肉强食，就是‘废品终点站’的规则，
点燃一支烟掩盖臭味，车夫拿起铲子，开始清扫那辆满是污渍的马车。
在车夫忙的满头大汗时，苏晓仿佛一只野猫般，悄无声息的来到车夫身后，就在苏晓准备打晕车夫时，脚下却踩到了一个半碎的玻璃杯。
“咔吧。”一声脆响传来，车夫的身体一抖。
苏晓也是一惊，在这脏乱的‘废品终点站’，脚下是很深一层垃圾，踩上去非常松软，根本察觉不到脚下有什么。
但此时箭在弦上不得不发，所以苏晓直接扑上前去。
那名车夫也不是什么良善之辈，转身拔出腰间的匕首，直接向苏晓刺来。
车夫那凶恶的表情让苏晓明白，对方是想要他的命。
苏晓的目光开始冰冷起来，在这任务世界，不是你死就是我亡，对敌人的仁慈，就是对自己的残忍。
举起手中的燧发枪，苏晓将枪口对准了车夫的头。
如果是普通人被枪指着，绝对会马上停止或后退，可这名车夫不同，他居然更快的扑来。
苏晓面无表情的扣下了扳机，枪体后的击锤撞在燧石上，火星溅射而出，枪膛内的火药被引燃，在狭小空间内大量火药被引燃，爆发出强大的动能，随着火光与烟雾四溢，枪膛内的弹丸喷发而出。
“砰。”
浓烟升起，一股刺鼻的火药臭味传开，一颗铅弹直接没入车夫的头颅，车夫前冲的身形戛然而止，直接被打退出两米远，身体抽搐两下后死亡。
【提示：你杀死了黑市商人】

【你的天赋‘噬灵者’发动，永久增加5点法力值，现有法力值65点。】
【你获得宝箱（白】
【这是你首次杀敌，储蓄空间开启（2平米），在返回轮回乐园后，储蓄空间可使用乐园币升级大小。】
轮回乐园的提示让苏晓知道，这根本不是车夫，而是一位黑市商人，应该是利用车夫的身份在废品终点站内做着某种交易。
黑市商人死后，尸体上方漂浮着一个木箱，箱子整体成白色，只有手掌大小。
苏晓尝试将漂浮在半空的木箱拿起，虽然只有手掌大小，但入手沉重。
【宝箱（白)，是/否开启】
苏晓并没有
意念一动，【破旧的燧发枪】在手中出现，苏晓对新出现的储物空间很满意，这是个非常实用的功能。如果利用好这种能力，对他完成任务有很大帮助。
这里并不安全，所以苏晓没有选择了，现在首要的是进入‘哥亚王国’的首都城。
苏晓把上衣脱下，换上那名黑市商人的衣物。
犹豫了一下，苏晓直接扑倒在地面的沾水中，恶臭传来，他的衣服和脸颊上，都沾染了大片污水，让人无法看清他的面容。
坐在马车前，苏晓有些生疏的操控着马匹，向城内行进。
此时他手中拿着一把匕首，正是那名黑市商人手中的匕首，但这把匕首，与他想象的有些不同。

content_en:
Mia nodded, but then immediately shook her head.
At the scrap terminal, there is one thing that is most scarce, and that is food. Those refugees who do not care about production and only rely on scavenging for a living are basically on the verge of starvation.
Su Xiao took out a few compressed biscuits in his arms, which were emergency food he carried with him.
He had observed that there was a forest far away from the 'Scrap Terminal'. He had a gun in his hand and would not worry about food.
Mia took a piece of compressed biscuit with some fear. She had never seen this kind of food before.
Under Su Xiao's guidance, Mia peeled off the compressed biscuit and took a bite carefully.
"Delicious~."
The girl, who had been hungry all day, started to eat hungrily.
"Your name is Mia, and take me out of here. These cookies are all yours."
Mia, who had finished all the compressed biscuits in her hand, stared at the several compressed biscuits in Su Xiao's hand and swallowed.
"Okay, but you can't hurt me."
Su Xiao did not answer the other party, but dug out of the dilapidated house, and Mia, who had recovered a little, followed closely.
"Where are you going? You are not a resident of the 'Scrap Terminal', are you?"
Su Xiao's footsteps suddenly stopped, a cold light appeared in her eyes, she threw a compressed biscuit in her hand on the ground, and then crushed it with her foot.
"Take me out of here and don't ask anything else."
If the girl Mia showed any abnormality, Su Xiao's gun-tight hand would be aimed at Mia's forehead.
Mia was startled by Lidya Su's actions and took a few steps back.
"Okay~, okay."
Mia didn't dare to say anything anymore and walked quickly ahead.
"Take me to the entrance of the 'Kingdom of Goa'."
Su Xiao looked around vigilantly, and from time to time he could see refugees with fierce eyes. After those refugees noticed the gun in Su Xiao's hand, they immediately put away their greedy eyes.
Recalling the information obtained from the anime, Su Xiao began to think about the next countermeasures.
The so-called 'waste terminal' is actually a large garbage dump. The current scene was created because the 'Kingdom of Goa' dumped a large amount of domestic waste outside the city.
Those refugees with fierce looks were originally just residents of the Kingdom of Goa. These people either committed serious crimes or offended the nobles, so they were driven here.
The waste produces a toxin-laden smoke that spreads in the 'waste terminal', corroding the lives of the refugees at all times.
The most obvious manifestation is that Su Xiao's health value has dropped from 100% to 98%.
There are no doctors and no food in the 'waste center'. Crime and disease are spreading here. It is a lawless zone, and everything is based on the strength of the force.
Following Mia's guidance, Su Xiao quickly walked out of the 'Scrap Terminal' and came to a high wall.
A high wall made of black stones stood tall, and a small city gate appeared in Su Xiao's sight.
"We can only go here. The 'Kingdom of Goa' has laws. Refugees cannot enter the city. Once discovered, they will be executed."
Although Mia was talking to Su Xiao, her eyes kept staring at the compressed biscuits in Su Xiao's hand.
Throwing the compressed biscuit to Mia, Su Xiao ignored him, and Mia ran away directly. She led Su Xiao only because of the temptation of food, and for no other reason.
The gate of the 'Kingdom of Goa' was wide open, with several guards standing on both sides of the gate.
This is just a side door for dumping garbage.
Although those guards seemed lazy, there was a cold light flashing in their eyes from time to time. These guards should often kill people who try to break into the city.
Su Xiao hid aside and was not in a hurry to enter the city. He was waiting for the opportunity.
It is impossible to fight head-on with those guards. The residents of the pirate world are extremely strong. The girl Mia was able to return to normal in a short time after being hit hard by him, which made Su Xiao wary.
Su Xiao guessed that the attributes of those guards were at least ten points, and possibly even higher.
One hour, two hours, until three hours later, it was already noon, the temperature was rising rapidly, the weather was getting hot, and the opportunity Su Xiao had been waiting for finally appeared.
A carriage filled with domestic garbage drove out of the city, and the pungent rotten smell spread far away. The guards did not look at the carriage at all, but subconsciously took a few steps back.
"My lords, do you need a routine check-up?"
The driver stopped the carriage, a little afraid of the guards.
"Go away quickly, it stinks."
The guard waved his palms in disgust, showing no intention of checking.
When Su Xiao saw this in the distance, she raised her eyebrows and quickly followed the carriage.
After the carriage penetrated deep into the garbage mountain, it found an open space and started dumping garbage. The driver, who had been submissive before, suddenly had a dagger on his waist. The law of the jungle is the law of the 'waste terminal'.
Lighting a cigarette to cover up the smell, the coachman picked up a shovel and began to clean the stained carriage.
When the coachman was sweating profusely from work, Su Xiao silently came behind the coachman like a wild cat. Just when Su Xiao was about to knock the coachman unconscious, he stepped on a half-broken glass under his feet.
"Click." A crisp sound came, and the coachman's body trembled.
Su Xiao was also surprised. In this dirty 'waste terminal', there was a deep layer of garbage underfoot. It was very soft when you stepped on it, and you couldn't even notice what was under your feet.
But at this time, the arrow was on the string and had to be fired, so Su Xiao rushed forward directly.
The driver was not a kind person either. He turned around, pulled out the dagger from his waist, and stabbed Su Xiao directly.
The ferocious expression of the coachman made Su Xiao understand that the other party wanted his life.
Su Xiao's eyes began to turn cold. In this mission world, either you die or I die. Kindness to the enemy is cruelty to oneself.
Raising the flintlock gun in his hand, Su Xiao pointed the gun at the coachman's head.
If an ordinary person were pointed at by a gun, they would definitely stop or retreat immediately, but this driver was different. He actually pounced faster.
Su Xiao expressionlessly pulled the trigger. The hammer behind the gun body hit the flint, and sparks sputtered out. The gunpowder in the gun chamber was ignited. A large amount of gunpowder was ignited in a small space, erupting with powerful kinetic energy. As fire and smoke overflowed, the projectiles in the gun chamber erupted.
"Bang."
Thick smoke rose, and a pungent smell of gunpowder spread. A lead bullet penetrated directly into the coachman's head. The coachman's forward movement came to an abrupt halt, and he was knocked back two meters away. His body twitched twice and died.
[Hint: You killed the black marketeer]
[Your talent "Soul Eater" is activated, permanently increasing the mana value by 5 points, and the current mana value is 65 points. 】
[You get a treasure chest (white)
[This is your first time to kill an enemy, and the savings space is opened (2 square meters). After returning to Samsara Paradise, the size of the savings space can be upgraded using paradise coins. 】
The reminder from the Reincarnation Paradise let Su Xiao know that this was not a coachman at all, but a black marketeer, who should be using his identity as a coachman to do some kind of transaction in the scrap terminal.
After the black marketeer died, a wooden box floated above the body. The box was white and only the size of a palm.
Su Xiao tried to pick up the wooden box floating in the air. Although it was only the size of a palm, it was heavy to hold.
[Treasure chest (white), yes/no to open]
Lidya Su did not
With a thought, the [Old Flintlock Gun] appeared in her hand. Su Xiao was very satisfied with the new storage space. This was a very practical function. If he makes good use of this ability, it will be of great help to him in completing his mission.
It is not safe here, so Su Xiao has no choice. The first thing now is to enter the capital city of the 'Kingdom of Goa'.
Su Xiao took off her shirt and put on the black marketeer's clothes.
After hesitating for a moment, Su Xiao fell directly into the water on the ground. The stench spread, and his clothes and cheeks were stained with large amounts of sewage, making it impossible to see his face clearly.
Sitting in front of the carriage, Su Xiao felt a little unfamiliar.Controlling the horses, he marched towards the city.
At this moment, he was holding a dagger in his hand, which was exactly the dagger in the hands of the black marketeer, but this dagger was a little different from what he had imagined.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
